items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Stock button with a hand-drawn ink outline and solid ink fill (needs ink-frame), plus an sfx variant.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Stock badge restyled as a manga caption-box label: square corners, uppercase display face, hand-drawn ink outline (needs ink-frame), no press feedback, plus a spot variant for the one red label.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Stock separator drawn as one hand-drawn ink stroke (needs ink-frame).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Stock card drawn as a hand-inked panel on paper (needs ink-frame), with an optional solid or hatched ink shadow.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Stock input inside a hand-drawn ink outline on paper (needs ink-frame); spot outline when invalid.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Stock textarea inside a hand-drawn ink outline on paper (needs ink-frame); spot outline when invalid.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Stock checkbox drawn as a hand-inked box that fills with ink when checked (needs ink-frame).

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Stock radio group drawn as hand-inked circles that fill with ink when checked (needs ink-frame).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Stock switch with a hand-drawn tone track that turns ink when on and a paper thumb (needs ink-frame).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Stock select with a hand-drawn ink trigger and a heavy-outlined popup, no shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Stock tabs on a hand-drawn rule, the active tab outlined on three sides; line variant with an inked underline (needs ink-frame).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Stock dialog on an ink overlay, drawn with a heavy hand-inked outline and no shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Stock sheet on an ink overlay; its open edge is one heavy hand-drawn stroke, no shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Stock tooltip as an ink-filled popup with a heavy hand-drawn outline (needs ink-frame).

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Stock popover with a heavy hand-inked outline on paper and no shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stock accordion with hand-drawn item rules and a + / − ink glyph in place of the chevrons (needs ink-frame).

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Stock alert in a hand-drawn ink outline (needs ink-frame); destructive inks the outline and title in spot.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Stock avatar with a hand-drawn ink circle over the picture (needs ink-frame).

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Stock progress bar in a hand-drawn ink track (needs ink-frame), solid ink or a screentone fill.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Stock skeleton as a pencilled placeholder: a rough tone outline with hatched shading, pulsing (needs ink-frame); shape="ellipse" for round ones.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Stock table with hand-drawn row rules and a heavy header rule (needs ink-frame).

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: One manga panel: heavy hand-drawn ink frame on paper, optional screentone, corner caption and hatched shadow (needs ink-frame).

items.name: panel-grid
items.title: Panel Grid
items.description: Manga page layout: panels on a grid with paper gutters, column and row spans, one column on phones.

items.name: speech-bubble
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.description: Dialogue bubble with a hand-drawn tail: round, square, shout burst or dashed whisper, seven tail positions (needs ink-frame).

items.name: thought-bubble
items.title: Thought Bubble
items.description: Dashed hand-drawn thought bubble with a trail of one to three rough ink dots (needs ink-frame).

items.name: sfx-text
items.title: SFX Text
items.description: Onomatopoeia in the display face with ink stroke, hard shadow, tilt and a reduced-motion-safe pop or slam entrance.

items.name: vertical-text
items.title: Vertical Text
items.description: Vertical writing (vertical-rl) with text-orientation control for mixing Japanese and Latin.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Decorative radial or horizontal motion lines behind content, with density, colour and a movable centre.

items.name: focus-lines
items.title: Focus Lines
items.description: Decorative concentration lines bursting in towards a point, as inline SVG at the speed-line width.

items.name: halftone-background
items.title: Halftone Background
items.description: Decorative full-bleed halftone screen in three tones and dot sizes, with an optional top, bottom or radial fade.

items.name: emanata
items.title: Emanata
items.description: Inline SVG emotion marks (sweat drop, anger mark, sparkle, surprise lines, puff), labelled unless decorative.

items.name: ink-splash-loader
items.title: Ink Splash Loader
items.description: Loading status: an ink blot that pulses and splashes droplets, still under reduced motion, with a hidden label.

items.name: page-turn
items.title: Page Turn
items.description: Turns its children like a manga page when pageKey changes (right to left by default); cross-fades under reduced motion.

items.name: manga-frame
items.title: Manga Frame
items.description: Image in a hand-drawn ink frame with aspect presets, a halftone mat and a caption; alt is required (needs ink-frame).
